statement: The Solver can terminally seal a quest whose evidence is already committed at HEAD — a measurement-only (repro-on-HEAD) attempt path that records a measuring attempt against the current committed tree with an honestly empty source delta, so already-committed process/infra quests (parallel-evidence-machine-mutex, parallel-session-quest-leases, parallel-session-scope-advisory) are not unsealable purely because their implementation predates their quest declaration. The path must compute a reproducible verifier identity from committed refs (never a hand-written diff claiming content the working tree does not hold), refuse when the working tree has uncommitted changes in the claimed paths, and remain subagent-verifiable like any source attempt.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
